title: Outstanding Oven Roasted Ukrainian Chicken Breasts Kebabs
description: This Ukrainian dish features chicken breasts with a jammy and crumbly texture, made with coconut cream crack and low sodium ingredients, served in a fondue pot. It is an energizing and delicious meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut cream, cracked black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and salt-free seasoning blend.
Add the chicken breasts to the bowl and toss to coat with the coconut cream mixture.
Thread the coated chicken breasts onto skewers, if using.
Place the chicken breasts in a fondue pot or a large baking dish.
Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken breasts.
Roast the chicken breasts in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the chicken breasts from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
